embedded.courseOverview: The Embedded Systems course at Pumo Technovation covers hardware-software integration. embedded.fullCourseContent:
⚡ Embedded Systems, Firmware & IoT Architecture

A rigorous, industry-grade training program bridging bare-metal hardware engineering, deterministic real-time firmware, and scalable IoT cloud deployments.

🎯 Program Objective & Career Scope

To produce high-caliber embedded systems engineers proficient in 32-bit ARM Cortex architecture, FreeRTOS deterministic scheduling, high-speed PCB design, automotive communication buses (CAN-FD, LIN), and IoT telemetry architectures. Targeted roles include Firmware Engineer, Embedded Linux Developer, IoT Systems Architect, and Automotive ECU Specialist.

📋 Comprehensive Syllabus & Curriculum Breakdown

Module Key Topics Covered Hands-on Lab Exercises & Tools
Module 1: Embedded C & Data Structures Bitwise operations, memory-mapped I/O, pointers, circular buffers, stack vs heap, finite state machines (FSM), MISRA-C standards. Bare-metal peripheral drivers, interrupt service routines (ISR), GCC / Keil MDK.
Module 2: Microcontroller Architectures 8051, AVR ATmega, ARM Cortex-M0/M4/M7, clock trees, NVIC nested vector interrupts, DMA controllers, low-power sleep modes. STM32 Nucleo & NXP LPC development boards, J-Link debugging, logic analyzers.
Module 3: Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) FreeRTOS kernel, preemptive task scheduling, semaphores, mutexes with priority inheritance, message queues, event groups. Multi-tasking sensor hub with deterministic latency control and deadline scheduling.
Module 4: Industrial Protocols UART, SPI, I2C, CAN 2.0B, CAN-FD, RS-485, USB device classes, and automotive diagnostic standards. Mixed-signal oscilloscopes, Saleae logic analyzer decoding, CAN-FD bus analyzers.
Module 5: IoT & Cloud Telemetry ESP32 Wi-Fi/BLE, MQTT / HTTPS protocols, AWS IoT Core integration, JSON parsing, Over-The-Air (OTA) firmware updates. Edge-to-cloud smart energy monitoring station with live telemetry dashboard.
Module 6: PCB Design & Hardware Altium Designer / KiCad, schematic capture, multi-layer routing, decoupling strategies, EMI/EMC compliance, SMD soldering. Fabrication of custom 4-layer microcontroller development board with SMD assembly.

🔬 Advanced Hardware Lab Facilities

Students have full access to dedicated workstations equipped with 100MHz 4-channel mixed-signal oscilloscopes, 16-channel logic analyzers, variable DC regulated power supplies, hot-air SMD rework stations, and FPGA development kits.

💼 Placement & Hiring Partners

Graduates from Pumo Technovation's Embedded Systems track have been recruited by global technology leaders including Robert Bosch, Qualcomm, Texas Instruments, STMicroelectronics, Tata Elxsi, and NXP Semiconductors.

mechanical.fullCourseContent:
📐 Industrial 3D CAD Modeling, FEA Simulation & Robotics

An advanced design and manufacturing master curriculum combining parametric solid/surface modeling, computational physics simulations, and automated robotic systems.

🎯 Program Objective & Core Competencies

To train industry-ready mechanical design engineers in parametric Class-A surfacing, structural FEA stress validation under dynamic load cases, aerodynamics CFD modeling, automated CAM toolpath generation, and multi-body kinematic robotics simulation. Targeted roles include CAD/CAM Design Engineer, FEA/CFD Simulation Specialist, Robotics Engineer, and Automotive Product Designer.

📋 Detailed Syllabus & Technical Curriculum

Module Key Topics Covered Software & Hands-on Laboratory
Module 1: Parametric 3D CAD Modeling Sketch constraints, feature trees, complex sweeps/lofts, sheet metal design, weldments, mold design, Class-A freeform surfacing. SolidWorks & Dassault CATIA V5/3DEXPERIENCE modeling workshops.
Module 2: Finite Element Analysis (FEA) Von Mises stress criteria, mesh convergence, modal vibrational analysis, buckling, nonlinear transient dynamics, fatigue life calculation. Ansys Mechanical Workbench, structural stress heatmaps & factor of safety verification.
Module 3: Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) Navier-Stokes equations, turbulent boundary layer models (k-epsilon / k-omega), supersonic nozzle flow, heat exchangers. Ansys Fluent & CFX aerothermal simulation rigs.
Module 4: Industrial Robotics & Kinematics Forward and inverse kinematics, 6-DOF articulated arms, joint velocity profiles, collision-free trajectory planning. Robotic welding & pick-and-place simulation cells.
Module 5: CNC Programming & CAM G-code & M-code manual programming, 3-axis/5-axis toolpath strategies, feeds and speeds optimization, surface finish control. Mastercam / SolidCAM simulation & CNC machining center execution.
Module 6: Additive Manufacturing & GD&T 3D printing (FDM, SLA, SLS), lattice structure optimization, Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (ASME Y14.5), CMM inspection. Industrial 3D printers, laser scanners, and sub-micron coordinate measuring machines.

💼 Placement & Hiring Partners

Our mechanical engineering alumni are placed at prestigious manufacturing, defense, and automotive giants including Tata Motors, ISRO, Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL), L&T Engineering, Mahindra & Mahindra, and Ashok Leyland.

sap.fullCourseContent:
📊 Enterprise SAP S/4HANA Cloud ERP & Core Business Modules

An elite consulting and implementation curriculum covering in-memory HANA computing, advanced ABAP object-oriented programming, and core functional ERP modules.

🎯 Program Objective & Global Certifications

To train industry-ready SAP Functional and Technical Consultants equipped with deep hands-on expertise in S/4HANA Cloud Architecture, Core Data Services (CDS Views), ACDOCA Universal Journal financial ledger balancing, materials sourcing, and SAP Fiori UI5 enterprise apps. Targeted roles include SAP ABAP Consultant, SAP FICO Consultant, SAP MM/SD Consultant, and ERP Integration Architect.

📋 Module Syllabus & Business Process Curriculum

Module Key Functional & Technical Topics Live SAP GUI & Fiori Exercises
Module 1: S/4HANA Architecture & Basis In-memory columnar database, S/4HANA migration pathways, simplification list, Fiori Launchpad administration, client landscapes. Live SAP system login, transaction navigation, user authorizations & transport organizer.
Module 2: ABAP on HANA & CDS Views Object-Oriented ABAP, Core Data Services (CDS), AMDP (ABAP Managed Database Procedures), BAdI enhancements, OData service creation. Eclipse ADT development, custom CDS view modeling, and RESTful Application Programming (RAP).
Module 3: SAP FICO (Finance & Controlling) General Ledger (G/L), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Asset Accounting (AA), Cost Center & Profit Center Accounting. Universal Journal (ACDOCA) configuration, year-end financial closing simulation.
Module 4: SAP MM (Materials Management) Enterprise structure, material master, vendor master, purchase requisitions, RFQ, purchase orders, goods receipt (MIGO), invoice verification (MIRO). End-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) live enterprise procurement cycle.
Module 5: SAP SD (Sales & Distribution) Sales enterprise hierarchy, customer master, inquiry, quotation, sales order processing, pricing procedures (Condition Technique), delivery, billing. End-to-end Order-to-Cash (O2C) logistics and commercial sales execution.
Module 6: SAP Fiori & SAPUI5 Apps SAP Fiori 3.0 design guidelines, SAPUI5 MVC architecture, OData data binding, custom analytical cards, role-based Launchpad tiles. Building and deploying responsive approval apps on SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).

💼 Placement & Consulting Recruiters

Pumo Technovation's SAP graduates are recruited by top global tier-1 IT consulting corporations including Accenture, Wipro, Infosys, Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), Capgemini, and HCL Technologies.

plc.fullCourseContent:
🤖 Industrial PLC Automation, SCADA Systems & Smart Factory

A complete industrial automation masterclass covering hardware wiring, Ladder Logic, multi-platform PLCs, SCADA supervisory control, VFDs, and Industry 4.0 IoT protocols.

🎯 Program Objective & Industrial Roles

To train industry-ready Automation Engineers capable of architecting end-to-end factory control systems using Siemens S7-1500, Allen-Bradley ControlLogix, Wonderware/WinCC SCADA, servo motor closed-loop position controls, and PROFINET industrial networking. Targeted roles include PLC Programmer, SCADA Engineer, Industrial Automation Specialist, and Commissioning Engineer.

📋 Module Syllabus & Automation Architecture

Module Key Technical Topics Hardware Workbench & Software
Module 1: Electrical Schematics & Relay Logic Control transformers, contactors, overload relays, pushbuttons, pilot lights, emergency stop circuits, ISO 13849 safety categories. Hardwired relay logic control panels, digital multimeters, wiring terminals.
Module 2: Siemens PLC Programming Siemens S7-1200 / S7-1500, TIA Portal V18, Ladder (LAD), Function Block Diagram (FBD), Structured Control Language (SCL), DB blocks. Siemens S7-1500 hardware trainer racks, analog inputs (4-20mA / 0-10V), high-speed counters.
Module 3: Allen-Bradley & Rockwell PACs ControlLogix, CompactLogix, Studio 5000 / RSLogix 5000, user-defined data types (UDT), Add-On Instructions (AOI), sequential function charts (SFC). Allen-Bradley hardware test stations & Studio 5000 Emulate.
Module 4: SCADA Supervisory Control Screen animations, dynamic tag binding, historical trending, real-time alarm logging, recipe management, database SQL logging. Siemens WinCC Professional & Wonderware InTouch SCADA workstations.
Module 5: HMI Touch Panel Development Siemens Comfort Panels, FactoryTalk View ME, screen navigation templates, alarm banners, security user groups. Multi-touch physical HMI panels connected via industrial Ethernet.
Module 6: VFD Drives & Industrial Networks Variable Frequency Drives (Siemens Sinamics / PowerFlex), closed-loop PID control, PROFINET, Modbus TCP, EtherNet/IP fieldbuses. VFD motor test benches with optical encoders and torque dynamometers.

💼 Placement & Core Automation Recruiters

Our industrial automation engineers are hired by global robotics and factory automation leaders including Siemens, ABB India, Rockwell Automation, Schneider Electric, Honeywell, and Mitsubishi Electric.

mep.fullCourseContent:
🏢 MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) & BIM Master Class

An industry-focused master curriculum covering building services engineering, HVAC heat load calculations, electrical power distribution, plumbing hydraulics, fire safety design, and 3D Revit MEP BIM coordination.

🎯 Program Objective & Core Competencies

To train high-caliber MEP design engineers capable of designing complete mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection systems for commercial towers, industrial facilities, hospitals, and residential complexes. Key software masteries include Autodesk Revit MEP, AutoCAD MEP, Carrier HAP, Navisworks Manage, and Elite Fire Software.

📋 Detailed Syllabus & Technical Curriculum

Module Key Topics Covered Software & Hands-on Laboratory
Module 1: HVAC System Design & Psychrometrics Heat load calculation using Carrier HAP, psychrometric chart analysis, duct sizing methods (equal friction/static regain), chilled water piping, air handling unit (AHU) selection, and VRF systems. Carrier HAP v5.1, McQuay DuctSize, and Revit MEP air terminal layout.
Module 2: Electrical Power Distribution Design Connected load calculation, transformer & DG sizing, single line diagrams (SLD), cable tray routing, indoor/outdoor lighting lux calculations, circuit breakers, and earthing grid design. Dialux lux calculation, AutoCAD MEP electrical schematics, and ETAP SLD.
Module 3: Plumbing & Sanitary Engineering Cold and hot water supply hydraulics, fixture units (WSFU/DFU), overhead/underground tank sizing, gravity vs hydro-pneumatic pumping, sanitary drainage, vent piping, and STP integration. AutoCAD MEP plumbing layouts, pipe sizing charts, and NBC 2016 compliance.
Module 4: Fire Protection & Sprinkler Hydraulics NFPA 13 & NBC fire hazards classification, wet/dry pipe sprinkler systems, hose reel cabinets, fire pump head calculation, and clean agent gas suppression (FM-200 / Novec). Elite Fire hydraulics software, sprinkler grid modeling in Revit MEP.
Module 5: 3D Revit MEP BIM & Navisworks Clash Detection Multi-disciplinary BIM modeling, parametric family creation, mechanical/electrical/plumbing service coordination, Navisworks hard & soft clash resolution, and 4D timeline simulation. Autodesk Revit 2026 MEP, Navisworks Manage, and BIM 360 Docs.
Module 6: Green Building & Estimation (BOQ) ASHRAE 90.1 energy efficiency compliance, LEED rating criteria, quantity takeoff, bill of quantities (BOQ) preparation, and MEP contract documentation. Revit Schedule/Quantities, MS Excel BOQ estimation templates.

💼 Placement & Hiring Partners

Our MEP Engineering graduates are placed at leading MEP consultancies, BIM services firms, and construction conglomerates including Voltas, Blue Star, Sterling and Wilson, L&T Construction, Schneider Electric, and Johnson Controls.
